title: Counter-Strike

anticheat.note: VAC is userspace and runs under Wine; Counter-Strike 2 plays online under it here

provenance: Reported by JLiveOf (highball-db#240, 2026-09-27), Apple M1, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, DXMT mode, the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, rated 4 of 5 after 2 minutes: very playable, never quite 60 fps. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The 2000 original (GoldSrc). Reported very playable on the default engine r11 in DXMT mode on an M1, below 60 fps but not needing it. Steam also sells a native Mac build of it, which Highball points out on the game's page since 0.9.39. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Frame rate stays under 60 (reported on an M1, engine r11, DXMT mode).
knownIssues.fix: none needed per the reporter. The native Mac build on Steam is the other route.
